The '''Tingel Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] that acted as an extension of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. It continued out into [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].
